thread:
sara: Kicking off the three-wave rollout. US -> EU -> APAC. Holdpoints at each region for 20m. Pin v2.4.1 for canary.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for service/redwood-api @4325007779 — canary slice: us-west-2, size=50rps. Ping @sara when ready.

mike: Can we confirm warm pool available counts per region? need to know cushion for surge.

jia: warm pool now: US=120 GPUs, EU=60 GPUs, APAC=30 GPUs. Usable cushion ~ US: +40rps, EU: +18rps, APAC: +9rps.

dave: Pin request noted. Locking model version v2.4.1 on the canary route. Will add rollback tag `hotfix-rollback-4325`.

sara: Release window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. US canary start at 02:05. If smoke passes, EU at 02:35, APAC after EU hold. Keep manual throttle control ready. :eyes:

mike: Adding quick smoke: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .latency
# expect p95 < 200ms, errors 0
```

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for us-west-2 @4325007801 — rollout: 10% -> 30% over 10m. Logs: https://deploys/redwood/4325007777

sara: Observing initial traffic. p50 ~ 85ms, p95 ~ 210ms (slightly above target). holding at 30% for another 10m.

jia: Autoscaler cushion set to aggressive for US (scaleThreshold=0.6). Estimated time-to-scale < 3m.

mike: Decision tree: if p95 > 400ms OR error-rate > 0.5% over 5m -> immediate rollback to v2.4.0. If slow warmup but errors low, we can throttle back to 15% and wait.

dave: Noted rollback triggers. I pushed flag `deploy.hot_rollback=enabled`.

sara: After 15m hold: p95 trending down to 190ms, error-rate 0.02%. Moving US to 70%.

deploy-bot: us-west-2 slice scaled to 70% @4325007830.

sara: Preparing EU start. Requesting EU capacity affirmation from infra team.

jia: EU warm pool pump scheduled now. ETA for cushion readiness ~8m.

mike: EU pin will be sticky for 30m post-canary. If EU p95 > 350ms at any point, we pin back and open rollback window.

sara: Important: APAC remains on hold until EU reaches 60% and APAC warm pool >= 20 GPUs. No cross-region traffic shift before that.

dave: Marked APAC hold in release doc and pinned version on EU/US routes.

sara: Final notes: annotate release notes with: `canary pin v2.4.1`, `rollback-triggers: p95>400ms || err_rate>0.5%`, `manual-throttle-enabled`. Ops team, stand by for 02:40 handoff. :thumbsup:

mike: I'll watch the heatmaps and queue lengths. Ready to flip rollback if thresholds breach.

deploy-bot: canary fully promoted in US and EU @4325007850. APAC remain on hold by request.

sara: Great job everyone. Leaving APAC warmup to infra and will reconvene if warm pool hits target.

mike: Logging followup doc link: https://wiki.redwood/release/4325007777-postmortem-draft

(reacts: sara :rocket:, jia :white_check_mark: )
